description: This Java class 'ImmutableTopicPathPlaceholder' provides placeholder resolution for topic paths, supporting various placeholders like 'namespace', 'entityName', 'group', etc., and implements the 'TopicPathPlaceholder' interface.

classes.name: ImmutableTopicPathPlaceholder
classes.description: Immutable singleton class implementing placeholder resolution for topic paths, supporting placeholders like 'full', 'namespace', 'entityName', etc.

methods.name: getPrefix
methods.description: Returns the prefix 'topic' for this placeholder implementation.

methods.name: getSupportedNames
methods.description: Returns the list of supported placeholder names.

methods.name: supports
methods.description: Checks if a given placeholder name is supported.

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Resolves a placeholder to its corresponding value from a TopicPath object.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the class.
